exposure: Post-thawing embryo culture (2d embryos cultured to 3d)
Post-thawing embryo culture (2d or 3d embryos cultured to blastocysts)
cohort: The study included 678 consecutive frozen embryo transfer (FET) cycles performed between 2004 and 2017, excluding patients older than 45 years.
finding: Post-thaw embryo culture did not significantly impact most FET cycle outcomes, though culturing 2d or 3d embryos to blastocyst stage was associated with a higher multiple pregnancy rate.
birth_weight: Birth weight was measured as an outcome and found to be comparable across groups.
